title: Pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points='22,78 46,46 40,38 14,64' fill='#B8D4E8' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='46,46 40,38 52,22 56,30' fill='#D6E9F5' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points='78,78 54,46 60,38 86,64' fill='#8FB8D8' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='54,46 60,38 48,22 44,30' fill='#A8CCE2' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFD966' stroke='#FFF0B3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='80' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#FF6B6B' stroke='#FFB3B3' stroke-width='2' transform='rotate(-20 20 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='80' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF9999' transform='rotate(-20 20 80)'/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='80' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#FF9F43' stroke='#FFD9A3' stroke-width='2' transform='rotate(20 80 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='80' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFC078' transform='rotate(20 80 80)'/>
  <!-- Blade edges highlight -->
  <line x1='30' y1='70' x2='46' y2='47' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='70' x2='54' y2='47' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
